text:
aisha: Heads-up — planning retreat to align the roadmap and lock OKRs for the next two quarters. Two candidate windows: Jun 23-24 or Jul 7-8. Prefer Jun 23-24 to avoid end-of-quarter crunch. Need: date confirmation, facilitator volunteers, prework, and a clear way to surface customer-driven asks and measurable launch criteria. TL;DR: this is about scope negotiation, prioritization, and making launch decisions, not deep design sprints.

jordan: Jun 23-24 works for Eng. We can bring high-level capacity estimates and a cost/latency tradeoff slide. Happy to co-facilitate prioritization session. :+1:

srija: Jun 23 for me too. I want a 60-min design critique + persona journey session so we can validate user impact before we commit scope. I’ll prep 3 persona flows as prework. :sparkles:

liam: Jun 23-24 OK from infra side. Note: avoid last week of quarter (ops fatigue). We’ll need a small demo cluster (2 GPUs) for any infra proofs and an on-call rotation plan if we demo live. I can present a rolling-deploy risk matrix.

samir: Sales support — add a dedicated customer-asks readout. We have 5 enterprise deals asking for private deployment timelines and advanced routing controls. For closes, they want explicit "launch criteria" (SLA, audit logs, KMS support, and perf baseline). I’ll bring a prioritized asks list.

carla: Logistics — venue can hold 40, hybrid A/V is tested. I’ll book once date confirmed. Need final headcount by 2024-06-01 and dietary restrictions.

calendar-bot: Tentative event created: "Product Strategy Retreat" Jun 23 09:00 - Jun 24 17:00 (hybrid). RSVP by 2024-06-01.

aisha: Thanks all. Two quick asks: 1) facilitators — volunteers? 2) prework upload deadlines; aim to have core prework in by 2024-06-10 so we can synth before the retreat. Prework checklist (please keep it tight):

```
- Top 5 customer asks with 1-line impact estimate (sales)
- 2-slide product intent + target outcomes (PM)
- 1-page tech constraints + rollout risks (Eng)
- 3 persona journey flows (Design)
- Proposed launch criteria (SRE/Sales/Legal)
```

We'll use RICE + Cost-of-Delay as the primary prioritization approach; call out any assumptions. Also planning to run a "scope negotiation" round where each cross-functional group defends 1 high-risk, high-value item and 1 'nice-to-have'.

jordan: I’ll co-facilitate the prioritization workshop. I can also prepare a throughput vs unit-cost slide and a short demo of batching impact. :raised_hands:

srija: I’ll facilitate the design critique and persona sessions, will upload flows by 2024-06-10. If we need a quick UX research touchpoint, ping me and I’ll pull the latest NPS snippets.

samir: Sales will send the prioritized customer asks doc by 2024-06-07. Also flagging that any timeline we give for "private deployment" must include KMS and audit timelines — that’s a dealbreaker for some customers.

liam: Small note: engineering requests we treat model quantization policy and KV-caching rollout as established guidelines (so they don't become scope grenades). Propose we mark them as "pre-approved constraints" in the agenda. Also I suggest a live "blockers table" that we fill during sessions to capture unknowns and owners.

aisha: Great. Draft agenda below — please react with :thumbsup: if you agree or add inline comments. I’ll lock the agenda after votes and prework uploads.

```
Day 1 (Mon Jun 23)
09:00 - 09:30 — Welcome + objectives
09:30 - 11:00 — Product intent & top initiatives (PM)
11:15 - 12:45 — Prioritization workshop (RICE + CoD) — facilitated
13:45 - 15:00 — Design critique + persona readouts
15:15 - 16:30 — Tech feasibility & risk matrix
16:30 - 17:00 — Blockers table & decisions

Day 2 (Tue Jun 24)
09:00 - 10:30 — Customer asks readout + commercial impacts
10:45 - 12:00 — Launch criteria and rollout plan (SRE/Legal/Sales)
13:00 - 15:00 — Scope negotiation rounds (cross-functional)
15:15 - 16:00 — OKR alignment and commit decisions
16:00 - 17:00 — Action items, owners, timelines
```

If anyone thinks we should shift focus (more interviewing, fewer roadmaps), say now. Otherwise I’ll assume this template and lock the date Tue/Wed.

jordan: :thumbsup: co-facilitating, will upload materials by 2024-06-10.

srija: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup: I’ll ensure the customer ask doc includes explicit "launch blockers" so decisions are binary.

liam: :thumbsup: I’ll draft the "pre-approved constraints" section and the blockers table template.

carla: Booking hold placed for Jun 23-24. I’ll post venue details and shuttle options after headcount.

 aisha: Thanks everyone — final notes: aim for short artifacts, clear owners, and measurable launch criteria. If you have conflicts with Jun 23-24, please DM me by EOD.
